system.description:
During Combat, the user maintains a Dastard Clock, which is 8 Spans in size.

Whenever the user uses the Wait Action, or an action with the @Trait[set-up] trait (not inclusive of Resolution phase), Tick Forward the Dastard Clock by one Span.When the user declares an Attack, the Dastard Clock Empties.

For each Span removed in this way, if the Attack is a Damaging Attack, increase its Power by 10%. Additionally, for each 2 Spans removed, add +1 to the duration of any non-[Weather], [Terrain], or [Room] effects the triggering Attack creates or inflicts.
